sourceText: “I suppose, Lanyon,” said he “you and I must be the two oldest friends that Henry Jekyll has?”

attempts.label: primary
attempts.visibleOutput:
TRANSLATION: ona li toki e ni: “jan Lanjon o, mi pilin e ni: jan Jekil la, sina en mi tu li jan poka ona pi tenpo mute nanpa wan, anu seme?”
NOTES: NONE
